notes.title: New Update : Version 1.1.0 Released
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

This is the first update of SincereMen, we've been working hard on fixing bugs and we hope this hotfix release will bring a more stable experience
thanks for your patiance.


[h1][b]News:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Control Option:[/b] You can set control option first time you run the game after update, later you can change them in setting menu
[*][b] Turn ability:[/b] Now you can turn around by controller, you can enable it from control setting
[*] [b]Tutorial Improved:[/b] In the turotiral now you also learn how to holster weapons and grab them
[*] [b]Objectives indicator added:[/b] An arrow showes the direction of next objective
[*] [b]Explosive Icons:[/b] Now explosives has icon above them to see them easier
[*] [b]Weapon Recoil:[/b] Weapons recoil added when fire weapons, weapon recoil now deponds on if you holding weapon with two hands or one hand
[*] W[b]arning UI:[/b] Warning UI added to tell pleayer whats awaiting him
[/list]
[h1]
[b]Fixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Grabbing interactables are now easier
[*] Visibility of scopes has improved
[*] Your hands will automaticly release mortar handles when you move your hands away
[*] Now you can grab weapons easier from your back
[*] Health of enemies reduced in chopper mission
[*] Grabbing mortar handles now deponds on the direction of your hand when you grab them 
[/list]
